newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver end firm on global trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver end firm on global trends.

text.p: ** Silver (.999) closed 15 rupees higher at 7,525 rupees per kg against previous closing of 7,510 rupees but compared to the today's opening price of 7,540 rupees market closed lower.
** Gold 24 carat closed 10 rupees higher at 4,880 rupees per 10 gramme up against previous closing of 4,870 rupees on stray seasonal support.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed 200 rupees higher at 57,100 rupees per piece. They were steady on Tuesday but were down by 100 rupees on Monday.
